scope: 4 matched T2V cases, frames0/20/40/60/80; not a full-video or full60 acceptance
conditions: official native with no project weights
BT400 with all physical blocks off, trained LoRA retained

observations.VP002: Native and BT-noC retain natural wood/hand/background; native later forms a white triangular artifact, noC bends more smoothly but retains white underside. BT normal changes to dark empty field, separated strips and geometric arch.
observations.VP004: Native and BT-noC retain marked ruler and hand, both produce implausible fracture fragments. BT normal becomes blue bar/red fixture with lost markings and abnormal tearing.
observations.VP009: Native and BT-noC retain construction worker, natural glass and attached picture, but lifting/hand-tool action still wrong. BT normal shifts to deep blue glass and mostly removes worker.
observations.VP015: Native and BT-noC already misframe oar as boat-like object with elongated reflection and no full rower. BT normal adds strong blue cast and unstable surface geometry.

decision: Keep existing native video LoRA schedule; no evidence here for broadly freezing/removing it. Replace free physical residual image writes. Repair reasoning, while recognizing that base-model process/geometry errors also need useful physical guidance.
not_claimed: No whole-benchmark native score, no guarantee that proposed QK conditioning improves scores.
